backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, attendance tracking, ranking logic, and authorization‑protected profile updates.
backend/validation.mo: Validation module enforcing name rules with checks for emptiness, length, allowed characters, and reserved words.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI requirements to specific frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of various frontend files across state, UI, backup, theme, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark theme CSS variables and applying global background and text classes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting a solid dark initial background and theme color to prevent pre‑render color flashes.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app container handling routing, theme init, backend profile sync, and daily reminder integration.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Backup utilities for exporting app state to JSON and importing it with validation and migration.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Defines backup data structure, creation, validation, and migration logic for app state including settings and user fields.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Bunkab: Displays bunkable class count with loading, error, and status‑based UI using attendance calculations.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Animated circular progress component that visualizes a percentage with color‑coded stroke and optional label.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Renders an attendance summary card for a subject with stats, trends, alerts, and a circular progress indicator.
Provides the main app layout with header, footer, and padded content area to avoid bottom nav overlap.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Sheet UI for marking today's classes by loading scheduled periods and saving attendance events.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Bottom navigation bar with five tabs and active state styling for page switching.
frontend/src/components/pastAttendance/M: Flow for selecting a past date, loading scheduled classes, and marking attendance with validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Displays app information, version details, and founder credit in an about section card.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Backup and restore card allowing export of current state and importing a backup with confirmation before applying.
frontend/src/components/settings/LogoutC: Logout card with confirmation dialog that triggers logout and clears local data even if server deletion fails.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Notifications settings card handling permission requests, category toggles, limitation messaging, and test notification sending.
frontend/src/components/settings/Profile: Editable profile name card with validation, edit/save/cancel flow, and error handling.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Control for setting attendance target using a slider and numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Theme customization card allowing selection of light/dark/system mode and color variants.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Reusable destructive‑action confirmation dialog with customizable title, description, and action label.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu providing edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog for creating or editing a subject with name validation and automatic color/id assignment.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that classifies auth errors and shows session-expired or generic recovery UI.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the branded app icon with loading indicators.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Displays non-blocking error toasts using Sonner when an error occurs.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Pure utilities for computing attendance stats, safe bunks, required classes, insights, and streaks.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer managing subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, profile, and gamification state.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Type definitions for attendance domain, settings, notifications, user profile, and default state.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Generates predictive percentages, trend direction, and streak-based motivational messages.
frontend/src/domain/scheduleForDate.ts: Computes scheduled classes for a date by combining timetable slots with class exchanges.
frontend/src/domain/streakMilestones.ts: Calculates continuous day streaks and determines milestone eligibility and identifiers.
Validates display names with length and character checks, returning normalized results.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRecovery.ts: Provides logout cleanup and handles authorization errors by classifying them and resetting app state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBunkableClasses.ts: Fetches required attendance data and computes bunkable classes using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyAttendanceRem: Schedules and sends daily attendance reminder notifications after 7 PM if attendance is unmarked.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, loading stored identities and providing login/clear actions.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, theme variables, dark mode rules, and animations.
frontend/src/lib/authErrorHandling.ts: Classifies authorization errors into safe user messages and determines when logout is required.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Provides branding constants and theme-aware logo asset selectors.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Contains common utilities for classnames, dates, IDs, colors, and date comparisons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Provides helper functions to generate notification messages for attendance markings and combined status updates.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Wraps the browser Notifications API with support checks, permission handling, sending notifications, and click callbacks.
frontend/src/notifications/reminderFailu: Generates rate-limited, user-friendly error messages for reminder notification failures using localStorage.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Home dashboard handling streak milestone rewards, notifications, subject summaries, and navigation to marking flows.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Simple name-based login form with validation and simulated async submission creating a local user profile.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings UI allowing profile edits, notification preferences, theme selection, backups, and a robust logout process.
frontend/src/pages/StatsPage.tsx: Displays overall attendance statistics with charts and breakdown cards for attended, missed, and cancelled classes.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Renders detailed subject statistics, bunk/target calculators, recent activity, and edit/reset/delete actions. Pulls data from store and updates subjects via dispatched actions.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Displays a weekly timetable grid with edit mode for assigning subjects to time slots. Updates timetable slots through the app store.
frontend/src/rank/ConfettiBurst.tsx: Generates a lightweight animated confetti overlay with randomly timed particles. Used for celebrating top-ranked users.
frontend/src/rank/rankApi.ts: Legacy API layer delegating ranking operations to RankingService while converting data to older formats.
frontend/src/rank/RankBadge.tsx: Shows a styled rank badge with special designs for ranks 1–3 and gradient badges for others. Visualizes the user's leaderboard position.
frontend/src/rank/rankCache.ts: LocalStorage-based cache for ranking data with validation and safe load/save behavior.
frontend/src/rank/RankingModel.ts: Defines ranking UI types and mapping utilities to convert backend ranking data to UI entries. Includes validation helpers for ranking entries.
frontend/src/rank/RankingRepository.ts: Provides methods to fetch paginated or full leaderboard data and submit points via the backend canister. Maps backend results into UI ranking entries.
frontend/src/rank/RankingScreen.tsx: Main leaderboard UI with polling, error handling, auto-scroll to user, confetti for top ranks, and integration with RankingService. Manages ranking state and refresh logic.
frontend/src/rank/RankingService.ts: Service wrapper for ranking operations with backend-first fetch, auth error handling, and cache fallback.
frontend/src/rank/RankPage.tsx: Loads actor, user profile, and identity before rendering the ranking screen. Passes current user data into RankingScreen.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: React context store managing global app state with IndexedDB persistence and reset handling.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Loads and saves app state to IndexedDB with schema validation and defaults merging.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Low-level IndexedDB client for storing, loading, and clearing the app state.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies and initializes light/dark themes and variants based on user settings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining themes, colors, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Contains project metadata, architectural notes, feature requirements, and known issues for upgrading the BunkPro app. Documents attendance flow changes, notification additions, branding updates, ranking logic, and current bugs to fix.
